preconditions.description: The number of problems (n) and the number of experienced teams (k) are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(team[i] for i in range(n)) <= n // 2 for team in zip(*problems))
postconditions.description: Each team knows at most half of the selected problems.
